about_the_game:
Life in a megacity presses in from all sides - concrete, glass, endless gray. But when a simple packet of seeds arrives at your door, everything changes. What starts as a single pot on a windowsill becomes something more: the quiet joy of watching green push through soil, the rhythm of watering and waiting, the first taste of a tomato you grew yourself. Your apartment begins to breathe. And for the first time, the city feels like it might actually become home, because now you have your Tiny Eden.

  • Grow
    Plant flowers, berries, and vegetables right in your living room. Nurture them through every stage - from seed to sprout to harvest. With realistic soil chemistry and distinct growth phases, every plant feels alive. Watch your windowsill turn into a green corner, and that corner into a whole green room.

  • Craft & Cook
    Transform what you grow into something even better. Create and cook your own recipes via the kitchen. From fresh salads to baked goods - create meals that actually taste like home. Sell them at the market, or support your neighbours. You've earned it.

  • Sell & Expand
    The city is hungry for real food. Sell your harvest and handmade goods to the people, then reinvest in your little farm. Create your own signature recipes, set up automation, craft your space — turn your small apartment into a productive green sanctuary. Every tomato brings you closer to the next upgrade.

  • Design Your Space
    Decorate your home your way. Dozens of interior items let you build a space that truly feels like you - whether it's a cozy jungle hideaway or a clean, efficient growing station. Here, plants aren't just crops. They're part of your home.

short_description: A peaceful first-person farming sim in the heart of a futuristic city. Turn your small apartment into a thriving smart garden. Grow plants, cook meals, sell your harvest, and expand your urban farm - from a single windowsill all the way to a rooftop paradise.
supported_languages: English, Russian, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Belarusian
